title: JKL Trail Rides
specs: Rides along Red Deer River with mountain views and wildlife including wild horses
Natural mountain waterslides and 250m James Falls waterfall on rides
E-bike tours near Banff National Park
Minimum age 8 years for rides and rafting trips
Boots with a heel and long pants recommended for camps and rides
Summer camps require minimum 3 participants, maximum 12 kids per camp
Event venue available for weddings, team-building, corporate events with horseback riding, rafting, hiking
includes: Helmets and life jackets provided for rafting
Home cooked meal or pastry and a hot or cold drink included in Ride & Raft and Dinner & Drift
blurb: Guests can explore the Rocky Mountains on horseback, raft down the Red Deer River, or take guided e-bike tours. The Diamond J location offers multiple trail rides ranging from 1.5 to 5 hours, including rides to natural waterslides and waterfalls. Summer camps for kids aged 8-16 provide horse riding lessons and outdoor activities.
extraNote: Payment must be made in full once you book for a ride or rafting trip · Cancellations rescheduled later in the season or next year due to short operating season · Wildhorse Flats cancellation policy: 7+ days before full refund in ranch credit; 4-7 days 50% refund in ranch credit; less than 4 days no refund · Diamond J location parking lot, 14 km west of Wildhorse Flats on gravel road near Eagle Creek · May Long to Thanksgiving (May 16 to October 12) 2026
